Its MANUAL_ONLY cost imports once; it has no formal START/receipt and needs no formal closer-of-closer. This does not pretend its native unknowns are known; missing own facts still block.

Role/source/current-command identity must come from authenticated actual source-private caller and real native owner checks; caller ID, JSON role flag, target pointer or financial predicate is never owner proof.
Every entry remains in authenticated current STATE/head/census. No subset ledger manufactured to hide target or unknown debt.

target_eligibility.blocking: Any unknown timing/terminal/cleanup/nonadmin tail, absent review/candidate, resource-invalid receipt, stale head, second other pending, or own mismatch denies this transition. Known failed costs remain charged even when CLOSE cannot proceed.
target_eligibility.cardinality: Exactly one distinct prior FORMAL_OUTER in FORMAL_AWAIT_CLOSE; target ID/command differs from closer and original sequence/terminal-before-closer chain is genuine.
target_eligibility.known_facts: Original terminal direct/session chain, actual whole target body endpoints/elapsed, owned cleanup/custody and independent financial adjudication all known and pinned; no partial local clock or PID/FD observation promoted to whole completion.
target_eligibility.registry: Actual current canonical formal registry/START/baseline/current-head lineage and exact pinned receipt/review match target. Receipt must satisfy all original field/price/resource/scope predicates; no invented CLOSE.
target_eligibility.visibility: Target remains pending and visible during preparation/publication; source checks label it prior target, not closer own reservation.

unknown_definition: Unknown blockers are unpriced/missing new body, native terminal, owned cleanup, nonadministrative tail, source custody/current head, or uncertain publication. The already permitted fixed historical physical-total null and declared ADMIN_ONLY_OPEN publication boundary remain recorded, never converted to zero or mistaken for known complete physical cost; they are not a newly hidden unpriced body.
